0022600220.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-8 and on a seven-game losing streak, host the San Antonio Spurs in their 10th game of the season, with Chicago 14th in the East and 4th in the Central, 5 games back. San Antonio enters 8-2 on an eight-game winning streak, sitting first in the Southwest and third in the West, with Devin Vassell, Jayden Quaintance and Tobias Harris all out. Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness) are both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions for Chicago, and the teams have not met yet this season after the Bulls lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026.
